caption: The drawing depicts a dark-colored horse figurine, predominantly rendered in deep shades of brown and black. The horse stands with all four legs visible, its right foreleg and right hind leg slightly forward, and its left hind leg bent back. The tail curves downward and then curls upward along the contour of its left hind leg. The mane is illustrated with distinct, wavy lines flowing down the neck, and there are subtle highlights indicating the contours of the head and body. The background is a plain, light beige color, creating a strong contrast with the dark figure of the horse. The artist’s signature, “CHRIS MAHRENS,” appears in small, capitalized text in the lower right corner of the drawing. No other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Toy Bank: Horse
